يستسمح (form X)
# يَسْتَسْمِحُ (yastasmiḥu) /jas.tas.mi.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# يُسْتَسْمَحُ (yustasmaḥu) /jus.tas.ma.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# يَسْتَسْمِحَ (yastasmiḥa) /jas.tas.mi.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَسْمَح
